# UC-LEARN1 — OAuth Academy

**Track:** learn  
**Maturity:** ✅ `works`  


## Buyer Story

An interactive teacher for OAuth 2.0 / 2.1 and OIDC — ask a question or watch a real authorization flow run live.

## PingOne Solution

Runs real PingOne authorization flows — PKCE, scopes, RFC 8693 token exchange, act/may_act delegation, HITL — with the actual token chain shown at every hop.

## How to Run

**Trigger:** Trigger (link): `{"type":"link","path":"/oauth-academy","label":"Open OAuth Academy"}`
